citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at about 2pm on
8/26/2026. The inspector attempted to contact employees responsible for USDA inspections by calling and talking to
available office personnel at the facility address. Personnel report that the biology division that was regulated by the
Animal Welfare Act (AWA) is no longer operating and has no plans to conduct regulated activity. The representative said
that she will check to see if any contacts associated with the former biology group can be reached (if needed) for future
visits.
Ensure to maintain access to records and licensed facility--failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records
for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in
enforcement action.
End Section
